checkpointPayload.description: Hide exact category/ID entries already listed with positive quantity in Items from the Resources view and its filtered export. Keep balances that have no Items row. checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Match Resources against Items inventory semantics by category/ID and positive quantity, retaining unmatched currencies/materials/refillables. 2. Apply filtering consistently to view, pinned count and export; compact the responsive grid/toolbar. 3. Verify real SFC state/rendering, cross-category collisions, inventory changes and export/pin behavior; typecheck/build/version/docs and commit.
